from datetime import datetime

token = simple_note_token
now = datetime.now()
today = now.date()
title_today = f"Habit Tracking Log for {today.isoformat()}"

# Determine whether today's note already exists (exact title match)
existing_today = None
for n in all_today_notes:
    if n.get('title') == title_today:
        existing_today = n
        break

print('title_today:', title_today)
print('existing_today:', existing_today)

# Prepare new content from yesterday, but set practiced_good_posture to yes
yesterday_content = resp_y.get('content')
print('yesterday_content has practiced_good_posture line?', 'practiced_good_posture:' in yesterday_content)

# Replace only the practiced_good_posture line value
new_content_lines = []
for line in yesterday_content.splitlines():
    if line.strip().startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
        # preserve indentation none
        new_content_lines.append('practiced_good_posture: yes')
    else:
        new_content_lines.append(line)
new_content = "\n".join(new_content_lines).rstrip() + "\n"

# Show diff lines around the posture change
for line in new_content.splitlines():
    if line.strip().startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
        print('new practiced_good_posture line:', line)
        break

if existing_today:
    print('Skipping create; note already exists with id', existing_today.get('note_id'))
    created_note_id = existing_today.get('note_id')
else:
    create_resp = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        access_token=token,
        title=title_today,
        content=new_content,
        tags=y_note.get('tags'),
        pinned=y_note.get('pinned')
    )
    print('create_resp:', create_resp)
    created_note_id = create_resp.get('note_id')

print('created_note_id:', created_note_id)

print('today created_at:', show_today.get('created_at'))
print('today updated_at:', show_today.get('updated_at'))

# Compare to yesterday content with only posture line changed
yesterday_content = resp_y.get('content')
today_content = show_today.get('content')

# Build expected by replacing practiced_good_posture line with yes
expected_lines=[]
for line in yesterday_content.splitlines():
    if line.strip().startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
        expected_lines.append('practiced_good_posture: yes')
    else:
        expected_lines.append(line)
expected_content = "\n".join(expected_lines).rstrip() + "\n"

print('matches expected?', today_content == expected_content)

# Additionally extract just the posture line
for content,label in [(today_content,'today'),(expected_content,'expected')]:
    posture_line = None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            posture_line = line.strip()
            break
    print(label,'posture_line:', posture_line)
